# Coffee machine usage guide

## Knowledge

The kitchen coffee machine uses beans, not grounds. Fill the water tank every
morning. Descale monthly using the provided tablets.

## Consequence

No code impact. This memory is a deliberate distractor for retrieval benchmarks.
